title: Finite perfect local models before compatible morphism lifting
statement: Let X be Noetherian and A a commutative Noetherian J-adically complete ring. Use the coefficient comparison package [def-sfb-adic-residue-lift-comparisons]. Let M in D(B_X) be locally derived complete for ker(B_X -> underline(A/J)). Suppose its residue is the pro-etale comparison of a bounded etale A/J-complex C with locally constant finite-type cohomology and Tor amplitude [a,b], a <= b. Then there is a covering sieve S on the transported final object. For each f:U -> final in S there exist an affine weakly contractible V, a functor R:D(B_X|V) -> D(B_X|U), and a bounded finite-projective A-cochain complex P. Put T=(B_X tensor_A P)|V and L=M|V. There are isomorphisms R(L) = M|U and R(T) = (B_X tensor_A P)|U. Both T and L are locally complete, and for each n their actual derived reductions modulo J^(n+1) are isomorphic. No compatibility of these finite isomorphisms, no morphism T -> L, and no completed-coefficient isomorphism is asserted.

proof.text: Apply the covering-family finite-reduction model theorem. It supplies the covering family, affine weakly contractible objects V, bounded finite-projective complexes P and all finite-reduction isomorphisms.

Reuse AdicPerfectModel.complete_slice_model, the complete private finite-projective model argument in the completed perfect-model reduction module. Compare the strict-perfect constant functor with the commutative constant functor by constantPresentationIso. Whisker by coefficient extension, map the isomorphism to complexes and then the derived category, and use mapDerivedCategoryFactors for slice restriction. Transport completeness through this isomorphism. Independently apply slice completeness to M.

Generate the covering sieve of the family. For a member U -> final choose its factorization U -> V_i -> final. The derived functor of overMap along U -> V_i is R. The composition comparison for exact derived functors and overFunctorMap identify successive restriction with direct restriction; their components give both required object isomorphisms. Bundle these with the two completeness assertions and all reduction isomorphisms.

    (J : Ideal A) [IsAdicComplete J A]

        J 0) M)
    (C : CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.D
      (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.finite (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A J 0))
    (_hbounded : ∃ c d : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < c ∨ d < q →
      IsZero ((adicResidueCohomology.{max v (u + 1)}
        (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.finite (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A
          J 0)
          q).obj C))
    (_hlisse : ∀ q : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsLocallyConstantFiniteTypeModules
      (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) (A ⧸ J ^ (0 + 1))
      ((adicResidueCohomology.{max v (u + 1)}
        (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.finite (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A
          J 0)
          q).obj C))
    (a b : ℤ) (_hab : a ≤ b)
    (_htor : ∀ P : CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.Cx
        (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.finite (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A
          J 0),
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
        (J := smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X)
        (R := CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.finite
          (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A J 0) P →
      Nonempty ((CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.Q
        (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.finite (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A
          J 0)).obj P ≅ C) →
      ∀ (N : CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.Mod
        (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.finite (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X) A
          J 0))
        (q : ℤ), q < a ∨ b < q →
        IsZero (adicResidueTensorCohomology.{max v (u + 1)}
          (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.finite (smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} X)
            A J 0) P N q))
    (_hres : Nonempty
      ((CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.extend
        (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.projection (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X)
          A J 0)).obj M ≅
        (adicResidueComparison.{u, v} X (A ⧸ J ^ (0 + 1))).obj C)) :
    ∃ S : Sieve ((AsSmall.up : X.ProEt ⥤ coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X).obj
        (⊤_ X.ProEt)),
      S ∈ coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X _ ∧
      ∀ (U : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X)
        (f : U ⟶ (AsSmall.up : X.ProEt ⥤ coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X).obj
          (⊤_ X.ProEt)), S f →
        ∃ (V : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X)
          (R : AdicResidueLocalDerived.{u, v} X J V ⥤
            AdicResidueLocalDerived.{u, v} X J U)
          (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A) ℤ) (c d : ℤ),
          P.IsStrictlyGE c ∧ P.IsStrictlyLE d ∧
          (∀ q : ℤ, Module.Finite A (P.X q) ∧ Module.Projective A (P.X q)) ∧
          IsAffine ((AsSmall.down : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X ⥤ X.ProEt).obj V).left ∧
          AdicResidueSliceWeaklyContractible.{u, v} X V ∧
          let B := CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.completed
            (coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X) A J
          let T := (adicResidueRestriction B V).obj (adicResidueConstantPerfect X J P)
          let L := (adicResidueRestriction B V).obj M
          Nonempty (R.obj L ≅ (adicResidueRestriction B U).obj M) ∧
          Nonempty (R.obj T ≅ (adicResidueRestriction B U).obj
            (adicResidueConstantPerfect X J P)) ∧
          CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.IsComplete
            (adicResidueLocalProjection.{u, v} X J V 0) T ∧
          CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.IsComplete
            (adicResidueLocalProjection.{u, v} X J V 0) L ∧
          ∀ n : ℕ, Nonempty
            ((adicResidueLocalReduction.{u, v} X J V n).obj T ≅
              (adicResidueLocalReduction.{u, v} X J V n).obj L)
